title: Service Ad Without Source Assets
tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

faults.what: The demo screen contains garbled headings and labels, with blue strokes standing in for task descriptions. This prevents it from reading as a credible, understandable daily-planning app.
The final ClearDay branding sits in a large dark-gray rectangle that obscures the lower demo screen and feels disconnected from the otherwise soft blue-and-white design.

judge.summary: The calm blue-and-white ad shows scattered task cards becoming a timeline and ends on ClearDay, but the garbled demo text needs correction.

must_haves.item: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The clip is identified as eight seconds long, and the supplied frames are landscape 16:9.

must_haves.item: A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
must_haves.why: Scattered, tilted task cards align and consolidate into a vertical timeline inside the created app screen, although the plan is only schematic rather than readable.

must_haves.item: The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.
must_haves.why: Pale-blue backgrounds, white cards, blue marks, and generous empty space establish a calm appearance.
ClearDay is clearly readable in the supplied seven-second frame.
Audio cannot be assessed from the supplied still frames.
